defect: In the string-key branch of the second member loop the duplicate check consults intMembers by IntKey instead of stringMembers by StringKey, so duplicate string keys still reach stringMembers.Add and throw.
why: The change exists to stop duplicate keys from throwing while the member tables are built; this copy of the guard checks the wrong dictionary, so the crash remains for these members.
